summary.text: Jordan Rasmusson is a Republican state senator from Fergus Falls, Minnesota, who represents District 9 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Krystyne Knutson.
He previously served in the Minnesota House and worked in management consulting and investing.

paragraphs.text: Rasmusson lives in Fergus Falls, Minnesota, graduated from Fergus Falls High School, and earned a B.A. in government from Harvard College.

His career experience includes working as a management consultant with McKinsey & Company and as an investment professional with Bain Capital, and he has served on the board of the Fergus Falls YMCA and the board of the Otter Tail County Historical Society.
Rasmusson represented District 8A in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2021 to 2023 and assumed office in the State Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding Paul Gazelka.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are Capital Investment, Commerce and Consumer Protection Finance and Policy, and Human Services, where he is Ranking Minority Member.
